segments.description: Coaches, please welcome Michelle Jagadlay, a former Grand Sam champion and Billie Jean King Cup team member. With over 30 years as a tennis Australia certified coach, Michelle has guided players from community pathways to international success. In her presentation, The Power of Connection for Coaches, she will explore strategies to foster personal development and self-leadership in players and coaches alike. Welcome Michelle. Hi everyone, I'm Michelle Jagadlay. I'm a sports mentor for Jagad Sports. I reside, I come from Sydney, Australia, but I currently reside in Sunshine Coast in Queensland. Today I'm really excited to have the opportunity and I want to thank the Australian Open virtual conference for inviting me here to speak about connection and the power of connection. So today my topic's going to be the power of connection for coaches. I'm going to show you some slides now, so I'm going to share these with you. Okay, so as I said, the presentation that I will be talking about today is The Power of Connection for Coaches. Now, if you look at the left side, we look at more the external team, that's you, the coach, could be a parent coach.
